title: High-Speed Internet, Financial Technology, and Banking
eligible_reason: Staggered arrival of fiber-optic submarine cables across African countries (treatment switches on at country-specific years, 1994-2013; absorbing; 2 never-treated countries). Main tables are static TWFE with bank (or country) and year FE and no controls; Figures 4-6 are unstacked event studies with binned endpoints.
design_notes: Bank-year panel (dataset_banks: 629 banks, 37 countries, 1997-2018, unbalanced; 6,776 rows) with submarines_first = 1[year >= year_intro_first]. Country connection years in the bank data: 1994 (2), 1996 (1), 1997 (1), 1998 (1), 2000 (2), 2002 (10), 2003 (1), 2009 (3), 2010 (2), 2012 (5), 2013 (7), never (2). Countries connected 1994-1997 are always treated within the 1997-2018 window. Bank-level first-treatment years with pre-period observations in the Table 2 log_y1 sample: 15 distinct years (269 of 538 treated banks; 70 never-treated banks). Second treatment (Table 4): submarines_HQ = connection of the parent-bank headquarters country, with bank and country-by-year FE. Country-level RTGS panel (Table 5, Fig 5) balanced 37 x 22. Table 8 firm analysis uses WBES repeated cross-sections (ineligible). All reghdfe; clustering by country_id (Tables 2, 4, 6; Figs 4-6) or bank_id (Table 5 col 3, Table 7).
estimators_reported: TWFE event study with binned endpoints (reghdfe)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: 9 distinct country connection years observed switching on within 1997-2018 (1997, 1998, 2000, 2002, 2003, 2009, 2010, 2012, 2013) plus always-treated countries connected in 1994-1996; at the bank level 15 first-treatment years have pre-period observations.

priority_note: Design and code fully eligible, but the supplied .dta files are SYNTHETIC: the README states they were 'generated to be representative of the actual data' such that TWFE point estimates and SEs match the published tables (minor differences in Table 5, Figs 5 and B1) while other statistics differ. CSA/BJS re-estimates on synthetic data need not reproduce what the real data would give, so treat as data-doubtful; the authors offer the original BankScope/BankFocus-based data on request to licensed researchers.
screener_notes: Screened from the package only (no article text). Full-text flags indicate the paper mentions Sun and Abraham, but no modern estimator is implemented in the package code. Variable labels are stripped in the synthetic data, so outcome names (y1-y7) must be mapped to table columns from the published paper. Treatment is assigned at the country level while units are banks, so clustering by country_id (37 clusters, 2 never-treated) is the relevant leverage check. doall.do runs Tabs_2-6, Tabs_3-4-B3, Tab_5, Tab_7, Tab_8, Figs_4-6, Fig_5, Fig_8, Fig_B1.
